**Saint-Aubin clinic handover**

Established: 4,200 patients, 6 rooms; open 08:00–19:00 weekdays, 09:00–13:00 Saturday. 12 nurses in 3 shifts, 4 admin. Accreditation April 2022–April 2027; renewal needs infection-control audit. Average 180 daily consultations; peak 310 (January 2025 flu wave). No-shows 9%, down from 14% after September 2024 reminder texts.

Fixed: March 2024 fridge failure (€2,100 stock lost) → networked temperature alarm, checked daily, paper log backup after silent alarm failure. November 2024 concurrent record edit overwrote allergy field → records now lock while open.

Rules: no prescription renewal without consultation within 12 months (38 breaches found); vaccine stock counted twice weekly; excursions above 8°C reported same day to regional health agency.

Decided/postponed: second ultrasound (June 2025) pending utilisation study of existing machine; not done, saturation unknown.

Open: nursing coordinator vacant since August 2025; two senior nurses rotating cover, unsustainable beyond winter.
